wholePhysicalScope: Mapped named way 203122000 and Wikidata Q6125749 identify the building independently. The south and east fronts are supported by two archive views. The model follows the actual building center near the former city hall rather than the story’s broader location.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the historic city hall footprint, three green pavilions and the arched central portico.
limitations: Primary front and flanking ranges follow the 1939–1940 references and mapped extents. The rear elevations, small window proportions and restoration paint are representative.
The regional 20 m elevation field preserves the site grade. Individual curb and paving levels are estimated.
